description: Acquired by Salt XC · April 2026
Aikido is an application security platform that runs from code to runtime, built for developers rather than security teams.
ai|coustics is a real-time audio intelligence platform that makes Voice AI work in production and not just in the lab.

AlayaCare was founded in 2014 and is the parent company of Procura, Arrow, CIMS, and AcuteNet. The company offers an end-to-end software platform for home and community care providers to manage the entire client lifecycle, from referrals and intake, to billing and payroll. Its mission is to deliver home care of the future through transformative innovation, data-driven insights, and a superior care worker experience with better patient outcomes.
Acquired by BrandMaker · July 2021

AppDirect is the leading subscription commerce platform for selling recurring digital services. It is the only end-to-end commerce platform for monetizing and managing digital customer relationships. It works alongside some of the largest technology companies to simplify how companies find, buy, and manage technology.
atmio is a methane emissions monitoring and reporting platform for gas network operators under the EU Methane Regulation.

Atom Computing builds quantum computers using optically-trapped neutral atoms to create arrays of nuclear-spin qubits. We cool, trap, and control these qubits wirelessly using lasers. Our commercial platform, AC1000, harnesses the power of over 1,200 qubits to explore innovative quantum algorithms, pushing the boundaries of system performance and scale.

Axle Automation is a pioneering provider of AI-powered solutions for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance. The company leverages cutting-edge generative AI to automate manual compliance workflows, empowering financial institutions to scale their compliance efforts while reducing fraud, compliance risks, and operational costs. Axle’s AI agents handle critical compliance tasks including screening alert resolution (sanctions, PEP, and adverse media), suspicious activity report generation, transaction monitoring alert disposition, and business onboarding documentation review. By automating these traditionally manual and inefficient processes, Axle enables compliance teams at fintechs, banks, and other financial institutions to focus on higher-value work while maintaining regulatory standards.
Acquired by Disney · November 2012
Acquired by Intel · March 2014
Belfort is a company building purpose-built hardware that makes encrypted compute fast enough to use in production.

Bench IQ helps attorneys understand how individual judges interpret the law by using AI to analyze court data. This analysis uncovers the reasoning behind judicial decisions, informing their strategies and empowering them to deliver better outcomes for their clients.

Scientists often spend weeks or even months sifting through research to figure out which reagents to use in specific experiments. Not only is that an inefficient process, it often doesn’t work. BenchSci’s AI-assisted platform solves this challenge by automatically ingesting and interpreting millions of historical experiments from around the world saving scientists time and money and leading to more successful experiments.
Bettermode was founded in 2018 in Toronto, Canada, by Siavash Mahmoudian, Soheil Alavi, and Mohsen Malayeri.

Booksy is the fastest-growing appointment-based, mobile-first beauty marketplace connecting over 25M+ clients to over 100K+ beauty pros across the U.S., UK, Spain, France, Poland. Booksy makes it possible for clients to find, book, and pay for their favorite services while equipping beauty pros with the tools they need to manage and grow their businesses. Founded in 2015, Booksy is used weekly for more than 1.3 million appointments and streamlined business services, positioning itself as the leading platform for ambitious professionals and their loyal customers.

Botpress offers an infrastructure layer which developers can use to build both front-end and back-end bots (e.g. customer-facing chatbots, workflow automation, etc). It provides a seamless, affordable and rapid bot building experience, without creating limitations or compromising on quality, so developers can focus on building incredible experiences. The brand has been cited by numerous clients as the bot builder with quickest time to value as well as best combination of ease of use and customizability.

Branch Energy is a retail electric provider serving commercial, industrial, and residential customers. For qualifying businesses, Branch pairs electricity supply with behind-the-meter battery storage systems that it owns and operates to reduce costs and improve reliability, sharing the value the batteries generate for the grid back with customers through a guaranteed annual credit. For everyone else, Branch offers simple fixed-rate renewable electricity plans.
Acquired by Google · November 2012
Exited in Q3 2022

Cavelo helps businesses achieve attack surface management with automated data discovery, classification and reporting. Its cloud compatible cyber asset attack surface management (CAASM) platform continuously scans, identifies, classifies and reports on sensitive data across the organization, simplifying compliance reporting, vulnerability management and risk remediation.

Launched in 2016, Certn uses AI and machine learning to streamline the candidate screening process. Its expedited, frictionless background check experience allows employers to make fact based hiring decisions faster and better, reducing costs and giving them an edge in this highly competitive labor market. The team has built a proprietary screening platform that connects to all major global people data sources, which enable background checks to be completed in minutes instead of days or weeks. The company has also redesigned the candidate/tenant screening process, allowing them to use any mobile or desktop device to fill out their details and upload their ID and a live photo.
Acquired by Rubicon Project · May 2015
Acquired by Lightspeed · May 2019

Founded as Clearbanc in 2015, Clearco provides business-friendly capital for e-commerce companies to grow their businesses. Clearco makes it easier for entrepreneurs to grow their business without equity dilution, hidden fees, or compounding cost of capital. The leader in growth capital, Clearco has advanced over $2.5B, financing over 10,000 companies to date.
Acquired by Rockwell Automation · October 2023
Clove is a platform delivering financial advice at scale, combining human advisers with AI to reach the people the industry has priced out.

Cohere the leading AI platform for enterprise. Its world-class AI is uniquely suited to the needs of business, unlocking the value of the world’s unstructured information, and ushering in the next wave of value creation for enterprises, startups, and consumers across the globe.

Conduit enables fintechs, neobanks, and exchanges to connect their customers with high earning crypto-backed products using one API for DeFi. The company was founded in 2021, backed by leading investors in crypto and financial services.
Secondary · March 2021
Credibur is the operating platform for structured credit, connecting non-bank lenders with their institutional capital providers.
CreditApp is a modern finance platform offering an indirect lending portal and its CreditApp Confidence Score, integrating income, identity and fraud verification tools.
Acquired by Apple · March 2024
Delos is a European enterprise software platform for team productivity and workflow intelligence.

DIAMO is a revenue platform purpose-built for independent hotels. By combining dynamic pricing, digital marketing, and a high-converting booking engine, DIAMO empowers smaller properties to compete on performance without the cost or complexity of enterprise tools.

Built for the learning pioneers of our time, Disco is the all-in-one platform that enables virtual academies, bootcamps and communities to build and scale their learning empire. With its evolving set of tools, Disco provides everything this new breed of modern virtual school requires to deliver world-class learning experiences, grow an engaged community, showcase their premium brand, and save time on operations.
Secondary · June 2020

EnPowered is a pioneering cleantech company accelerating the use and adoption of innovative solutions in energy-intensive industries. The company’s platform provides convenient on-bill payments to enable the acquisition of energy solutions. The platform also predicts spikes in electricity prices, prompting assets to shift usage to save money and decrease emissions.

Feldera is the world’s first enterprise-ready Incremental View Maintenance engine. Built on award-winning DBSP database research, Feldera evaluates any SQL program incrementally by computing only on changed data, turning hours-long batch jobs into sub-second results while cutting compute costs by 95% and more. Founded in 2023 by leading researchers in database theory and distributed systems, Feldera is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

Fellow is an AI meeting assistant built from the ground up with privacy and security in mind. Fellow’s AI Note Taker automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings with human-level accuracy, and the AI meeting agent generates answers and insights based on meeting data. Fellow works with Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams and integrates seamlessly with over 50 tools like Slack, Asana, Glean, and Hubspot.
Acquired by Good Technology · June 2014

Flare Systems is a leading Digital Footprint Monitoring provider. Founded in 2017, the company enables organizations to protect their data, financial resources, and reputation by continuously monitoring threats caused by human error and malicious actors. Focused on technical data leakage detection, Flare’s technology improves visibility, enhances transparency and reduces mean-time-to-remediation (MTTR) by detecting and prioritizing technical data leaks and remediating digital risks in real-time.

Founded in Toronto in 2019 and launched in 2021, Float is trusted by more than 7,500 Canadian companies to eliminate expense reports, close books faster, and manage spend at scale. Built in Canada and designed for the country’s regulatory and bilingual requirements, Float pairs modern financial services and software with a proprietary AI layer, backed by industry-leading support. To learn more, visit floatfinancial.com.
Fractile is a company building in-memory compute hardware that runs frontier model inference an order of magnitude faster and cheaper.

gaiia is a leading provider of OSS/BSS solutions for the telecommunications industry, offering a comprehensive platform that includes billing, CRM, operations, automation, and more. Founded with a vision to simplify and optimize ISP operations, gaiia empowers providers worldwide to deliver exceptional services and drive growth in the digital age.

Good Start Labs aligns AI through entertainment. The company builds gaming environments and partners with popular existing games so that millions of players naturally help evaluate and train AI models just by playing. Public leaderboards surface which models best handle both subjective human skills (e.g. humour, preference) and objective ones (e.g. strategy, planning). Over time, this helps create AI tools that are better aligned with human tastes and values.
GoodFit is a GTM intelligence platform for revenue leaders.
Acquired by Bazaarvoice · December 2023

Great Question is transforming how companies connect with their customers. The platform unifies the entire research process — from recruitment and scheduling to interviews, analysis, and sharing — in one AI-powered workspace designed for researchers, designers, and product teams alike.

Guesty is the all-in-one platform that automates and optimizes operations for short-term rental businesses. The company ensures hospitality businesses can streamline and achieve growth while delivering the best value to guests. With a complete suite of features and 200+ industry partners, including major booking OTAs like Airbnb, Vrbo, booking.com, Tripadvisor, Expedia, Hopper, Google Travel and Home & Villas by Marriot, Guesty is transforming the short-term rental industry with innovative solutions.
Handhold is a platform of AI agents that run tailored product demos and onboarding for every prospect, around the clock.

Headquartered in Montréal, Canada, Hopper is on a mission to build the world’s most customer-centric travel marketplace. Hopper aspires to help everyone discover the planet by making it cheaper and easier to travel. Through data and AI-driven pricing recommendations, Hopper takes the stress out of high prices, frequent delays, and lingering uncertainty for travelers in North America and globally. Hopper has created a full suite of fintech products to address these pain points and provide unique peace-of-mind flexible products (eg. Price freeze, Cancel for Any Reason and Leave for Any Reason).

InfinitySPM’s mission is to empower enterprise organizations to develop their best revenue strategies through a comprehensive and unified approach to planning that integrates finance, operations, and sales. Their aim is to drive sales excellence and optimize incentives by leveraging a fully integrated Sales Performance Management (SPM) platform. Their solution streamlines territory, quota, and sales capacity planning, linking these efforts directly to incentive compensation. This ensures transparency and alignment across all departments, fostering an environment where sales and financial strategies converge for optimal business outcomes.
Simulation AI generating realistic NPC behaviors for autonomous vehicle and robotics testing.
Acquired by AMN Healthcare Services · June 2026

Katalyze AI is a vertical AI company building the leading agentic operating platform for pharma. The platform connects and enriches siloed manufacturing and quality data to support process design, optimization, and automation in GxP-regulated environments — with a focus on improving yield, traceability, and cycle time. Its AI agents think like biochemists, resolve deviations 2× faster than human teams, and integrate with 40+ enterprise connectors without changes to existing infrastructure. Katalyze accelerates processes for the world’s largest pharma companies across North America and Europe.
Kopa AI is a platform of AI agents that build and run the ads bringing local clients to service businesses.
LabGenius is a closed-loop platform that combines machine learning and robotic automation to discover next-generation therapeutic antibodies.
Acquired by Check Point · October 2025

Since those early days of prospecting, the data, tools and technologies have evolved. But this evolution has led to fragmented teams, high costs, and inefficiencies. What if we could harness machine intelligence with top human performance to out-compete and out-execute anyone?

Lark Hospitality offers a comprehensive solution for hotel owners, enabling them to efficiently manage their properties while maximizing profitability and guest satisfaction. Its tech-enabled platform automates back-office and administrative functions, empowering on-site staff to excel with minimal training or prior experience.
Latent Labs is a generative AI platform that accelerates biological discovery and protein design.
IPO · NYSE & TSX · March 2019
Acquired by Airbnb · November 2011
Acquired by Airbnb · February 2017
macrocosm is a platform running bottom-up simulations of the real economy for institutions allocating capital, managing risk and setting policy.

Medeloop is a cutting-edge AI startup based in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing medical research through advanced technology. Their platform streamlines the research process, from grant discovery and application to data integration and analysis. By converting diverse medical data into a graph database, Medeloop enhances insights and facilitates connections to external databases. Medeloop autonomous research agent excels in analyzing complex data sets to identify biomarkers, biological pathways, and potential drug targets. Founded on the Stanford campus by leading AI experts, Medeloop collaborates with prestigious organizations driving forward the future of medical research.
Acquired by Yahoo · May 2013
Miru is an insider threat detection platform working across cloud and endpoints, with autonomous investigation and real-time response.
Mobai is a biometric face verification platform that catches morphs, deepfakes and presentation attacks in identity checks.
Modem turns scattered feedback – from users, teammates, and software – into actionable, living issues. Save time, reduce bottlenecks, and ship faster.
Acquired by Salesforce · February 2026
Motion helps Creative Strategists drive more revenue from their ad creative.
Mozart AI is a generative audio workstation that acts as a co-producer, building tracks step by step rather than generating finished songs.

Nacelle is a headless commerce platform spearheading a new type of website architecture built using Jamstack. Designed as an API-driven platform, Nacelle integrates with best-in-class eCommerce technology solutions to provide a seamless, high-performance infrastructure to support front-end website development. With Nacelle, retailers can accelerate their existing tech stack, without risky or lengthy backend data migrations.
Nano Corp is a deep-learning network intelligence platform for real-time cybersecurity threat detection.
Acquired by Snowflake · June 2023
Neo Financial was built on the premise that Canadians have been underserved in their finances for far too long.

Neo4j is the world’s leading graph data platform, helping organizations – including Comcast, ICIJ, NASA, UBS, and Volvo Cars – capture the rich context of the real world that exists in their data to solve challenges of any size and scale. Its customers transform their industries by curbing financial fraud and cybercrime, optimizing global networks, accelerating breakthrough research, and providing better recommendations. Neo4j delivers real-time transaction processing, advanced AI/ML, intuitive data visualization, and more.
Nexcade is a platform of AI agents that run quoting, tenders and bookings for freight forwarders, with the team in control at every step.
Acquired by Google · June 2020

Not Diamond is building an AI model router that automatically sends queries to the best-suited models, outperforming every foundation model on accuracy while reducing costs and latency. Our long-term mission is to build infrastructure that enables seamless interaction in an increasingly diversified landscape of foundation models, fine-tunes, and custom inference engines, making AI more powerful, computationally efficient, and safe.

Founded in Montreal in 2019, Novisto has built a modern, user-friendly, market-leading platform that is instrumental in simplifying ESG reporting. Its broader focus complements the large volume of carbon reporting focused tools currently available in the market.

Nue.io is transforming the way B2B SaaS companies manage their revenue lifecycle. Designed to replace legacy CPQ and billing systems, Nue is a seamless, end-to-end platform that enables businesses to price, quote, sell, bill, and recognize revenue for all revenue channels, with greater speed, flexibility, and accuracy.
Numbi is a platform providing accounting, tax and payroll for Latin American businesses, run by expert accountants on an AI-native back office.
Acquired by Collective Media · February 2011

Tugboat Logic by OneTrust is the Security Assurance Platform. Unlike traditional consulting firms, only Tugboat Logic provides automated technology to demystify the process of creating and managing an InfoSec program. With Tugboat Logic, enterprises can quickly get secure and prove it to customers. Powered by artificial intelligence, Tugboat Logic’s patent-pending technology automates InfoSec policy creation, security audit readiness, and security questionnaire response so enterprises can gain trust with customers and sell more. Tugboat Logic cuts the time and cost of audit readiness in half, helps startups and SMBs respond to security questionnaires 45% faster, and builds a complete InfoSec plan in minutes. Tugboat Logic is a cloud-based subscription service.

Optionality is a co-pilot for advisors. The company uses generative AI to accelerate value creation and the M&A process, empowering advisors to become trusted advisors at scale by maximizing their clients’ business value and planning their exit.

Paraito is an AI company building the intelligence layer for law and land. Its first product accelerates one of real estate’s most manual, highest-stakes tasks — the title search — by having AI agents gather the relevant acts from the land registry, extract what matters, and return a structured, analysis-ready file, cutting manual collection time by up to 70% and letting firms handle roughly three times the files without adding headcount. Trained specifically on the land registry and legal framework it serves, it’s already in daily use by notaries and legal, real-estate, and construction professionals. Its next product, Paraito Vista, extends the same engine from law to land: it stacks dozens of spatial data layers onto a single AI-powered map so anyone can ask questions like “what’s the zoning, flood risk, and ownership history for this parcel?” in plain language — turning fragmented property and geographic data into something anyone can interrogate in their own words.

Parameter is an AI-native continuous security platform that runs autonomous pentesting, cloud security, and supply chain testing around the clock. Its agents probe web apps, APIs, and infrastructure the way a human red team would, validating every finding with a working proof-of-concept rather than flagging surface-level signatures, and shipping remediation guidance the same day.

PayShepherd is how data-driven heavy industrial enterprises streamline contractor management. Their cloud-based solution automates contract compliance, resulting in real-time cost reporting, shared accountability, effective risk management, and governance. The single source of data mitigates legal and financial risks, driving the safe execution of work and protecting mission-critical Client-Contractor relationships.

Peripheral is building the spatial intelligence layer for live media. Founded in Toronto in 2024 by Kelvin Cui and Mustafa Khan, the company deploys camera systems in professional sports arenas and applies advanced 3D reconstruction to create real-time digital twins of live events. Its technology — rooted in autonomous vehicle perception research — enables interactive browser-based replays, immersive fan experiences, and high-fidelity player and ball tracking at arena scale. A member of the NBA Launchpad 2026 cohort, Peripheral is working with the NBA on the future of basketball officiating, injury prevention, and interactive media. The company raised a $3.6M Seed round led by Khosla Ventures, with participation from Daybreak Capital Partners, Entrepreneurs First, and Transpose Platform Management.
Secondary · March 2021

Photonic designs and manufactures large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant quantum computers that will transform materials discovery, computational chemistry, drug development, and secure communications.

In Canada, 80% – 90% of homebuyers secure their mortgages from big banks, largely due to lack of available alternatives. Led by founders Justin Herlick and Jonathan Shih, Pine offers an alternative to Canadian homebuyers and those looking to refinance their home.
Acquired by Wealthsimple · April 2025
Acquired by IFS · July 2023

poolside envisions a future where software and AI are seamlessly integrated, driving transformative progress across industries. Their advanced, foundational AI model is purpose-built for software engineering, fine-tuned to understand each team’s unique code and evolving needs. By offering a custom AI model, an intuitive assistant for code editors, and a developer-friendly API, poolside.ai empowers teams to code faster and more effectively.

Ranger AI is designed to transform the way industrial companies handle complex RFPs, RFQs, and engineering workflows. We combine multi-agent automation, document parsing, and collaborative knowledge management to help engineering, legal, and sales teams accelerate bid responses, reduce risk, and increase win rates.
RecordOS is an AI-powered platform for UK tax self assessment and Making Tax Digital (MTD).
Acquired by Cohere · May 2026
Repodo is an AI-native audit firm that automates statutory audits while licensed auditors retain final sign-off.
Acquired by ZMC · August 2022

ResQ founder and CEO, Kuljeev Singh, has a deep appreciation for the operational challenges that restaurant owners and operators face. That’s why he created ResQ, an end-to-end repair and maintenance platform that empowers restaurant owners and operators to request, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services with easy-to-use software. The platform also uses data-driven insights to help users make better decisions, thus driving savings and efficiencies.
Acquired by Shopify · June 2018
Acquired by H.I.G. Growth · July 2026
Acquired by ATPCO · January 2018

RouteThis is a leading WiFi in-home connectivity platform provider that is transforming the way ISPs and smart home brands deploy, manage, and support the connected home. The Company’s 100% software-based approach to solving in-home connectivity issues leverages the power of consumer smart devices so agents and consumers alike can quickly identify, resolve and prevent WiFi connectivity issues. Plus, with RouteThis Self-Help, consumers can solve connectivity issues themselves without making a call to customer support.
Acquired by Kinaxis · July 2020
SalesAPE is an AI sales assistant that automates outreach, qualification, and follow-ups for revenue teams.

In 2019, Ryan got tired of seeing his sister, Dr. Katie, come home two hours late from work every night. The main thing keeping her late was clinical documentation. As a software developer, he believed he could help and started working on Scribenote. The mission was clear: make clinical veterinary documentation completely effortless, just click a button, and your notes are done.
Secondary · October 2019

Launched in April 2022, Signal 1 is a health AI start-up with the mission to transform patient care through responsibly deployed AI. The company has strategic partnerships with Unity Health, a health network in Ontario and a leader in the application of clinical AI, and Layer 6, a division of TD Bank Group, and leading applied AI research group.

While major AI players pursue autonomous employees, Skyfall AI aims for an "autonomous enterprise" with AI as CEO. The company plans to acquire a small B2B business, intending to run it almost entirely with AI. Skyfall AI team believes true autonomy requires operating an entire business end-to-end, overseeing all functions from pricing to finance, and publicly documenting its success and failures. They argue current LLMs struggle with continuous learning in dynamic environments, proposing "Enterprise World Models" instead. This ambitious experiment seeks to prove AI can manage complex, evolving businesses, with humans shifting to oversight rather than daily operations.
Acquired by Zendesk · May 2019
SOLVE Chemistry is an AI platform that accelerates chemical research, formulation, and materials discovery.

Spare is a leading provider of mobility software. Its platform allows transportation providers both in the public and private sectors to automate their network’s day-to-day on-demand mobility operations. Its philosophy, which rests on its open API, is that anyone can and should be able to launch an efficient, well-run transportation network.

Spatial is the Metaverse for culture, experiences, exhibitions and events. It offers visually stunning spaces that are accessible via web, mobile, or VR, to help pre-build a utility for the creators that are the key drivers of Web3.

Spellbook is a Generative AI contract drafting solution for legal professionals. The technology, powered by large language models like OpenAI’s GPT-4, is optimized using legal datasets for superior contracting performance.
Acquired by BlueMatrix · January 2025

StrongestLayer is an AI-native cybersecurity company building email security and human risk solutions for the era of generative-AI-powered attacks. Its proprietary TRACE (Threat Reasoning AI Correlation Engine) orchestrates multiple AI engines to replicate the analytical capabilities of more than 1,000 security analysts, shifting email defense from pattern-matching to reasoning-based detection. The platform identifies sophisticated, personalized spear-phishing campaigns that evade legacy tools — and has already detected and neutralized millions of fake company websites used in phishing operations. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco, StrongestLayer emerged from stealth in July 2025 with $5.2M in seed funding.

Super.com is the all-in-one app that puts more money in your pocket! Save big on hotels, access a cash advance, get cash back on purchases, boost your credit score, earn money playing games, and more. Super+ members unlock even greater savings and earnings. The company is trusted by over 7 million customers and they have helped them save over $200M to date. Super.com is backed by Steph Curry and has raised US$150M.

Symend’s digital engagement platform uses behavioral science and data-driven insights to empower customers to resolve past due bills. Leveraging advanced analytics, Symend helps enterprises better engage millions of customers by providing deep insight into consumer behavior. Symend continuously optimizes these insights and empathetically nudges customers towards a desired action with personalized communications, self-serve tools and flexible repayment options.

Tailscale is a zero-configuration networking platform that lets teams securely connect their devices, servers and infrastructure without the complexity of a traditional VPN. Built on WireGuard, it gives people and AI agents private, encrypted access to the resources they need, wherever they are. Tailscale was founded in 2019 by former Google engineers.

Talent.com is the fast-growing global player in next-generation job search platforms. Based in Montreal, the company utilizes proprietary technology to match job seekers with relevant jobs while its pay-per-click model helps recruiters easily adjust their job advertising campaigns based on performance.
talentir is a financial infrastructure platform for the creative industry — automated, global and simple.

Tempo Labs is an AI-powered development platform that accelerates the creation of React applications. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Toronto, Canada, the company offers a visual editor with drag-and-drop capabilities, enabling designers and developers to collaborate directly on the codebase. Tempo’s platform allows users to generate and edit high-quality React code using natural language prompts and a visual code editor, streamlining the design-to-code translation process. This approach helps developers focus on business logic rather than CSS, and enables designers to ship pixel-perfect UIs without engineering assistance, resulting in faster product development.

Tera AI is developing a platform-agnostic, software-only spatial reasoning system designed to revolutionize robot navigation. By harnessing the power of advanced AI, Tera’s innovative solution empowers any robot to navigate its environment using only its existing camera, eliminating the need for costly additional hardware.

Higher education is at an inflection point. The demand to reduce the cost of a college degree while raising the quality, relevance and value of the learning experience for students is growing. Top Hat believes changing the status quo starts in the classroom.

TrackTik offers mobile and web-based workforce tracking, reporting and scheduling for security applications. Our investment in the company is rooted in our thesis for the future of work; we see technology as a means to help better connect multiple teams with each other and with management — ultimately improving services.
Acquired by Trackforce Valiant · June 2022

TripleLift is the advertising solution for the visual web. Images are quickly becoming the primary currency that brands communicate with their customers and TripleLift identifies how consumers engage with brands’ images across the web and uses that data to create more relevant and effective advertising. For example, our trending display unit identifies which images for a given brand are going viral or trending among their demographic, and displays them in real-time in dynamic ad units across the web.
Acquired by OneTrust · September 2021
Acquired by 33Across · January 2012
Upheal is an AI-powered platform generating therapy notes and session insights for mental health professionals.
Vasco believes scaling is a science and growth can be engineered. They help Revenue Architects find go-to-market fit, build a predictable growth engine and grow 10x faster.
Acquired by ServiceNow · April 2018

Vessel is building the intelligent infrastructure layer for private market fundraising and LP engagement — replacing manual workflows with AI-powered tools that help GPs raise faster, report smarter, and build stronger investor relationships at scale.

Vidyard’s mission is to transform how businesses drive growth through the use of video by offering best-in-class video hosting, video analytics, and video messaging solutions built for the modern era of digital-first business. The company has developed the most innovative video marketing and video selling tools in the world, integrated with leading marketing automation and CRM platforms to help companies embrace video as an integrated part of their marketing, sales, and internal communications programs.

Vital is working to invent and simplify diagnostics, ultimately empowering individuals to prevent disease. Vital is in pursuit of deployable technologies that can redistribute control to patients, and empower healthcare professionals in creating better outcomes.
Acquired by Nielsen · July 2012

Communication is built into many of our workflows today and continues to be embedded with almost every business process: Chatbots on websites, two-factor authentication using SMS within apps, transcription, translation, recordings, automatic call-backs…just some of the bits and pieces of ‘’communications’’ that are embedded in applications everywhere.

Backed by a team of world-class financial experts and the best technology talent, Wealthsimple has revolutionized how Canadians interact with their finances by bringing smart, simple, online financial products to market. We have been talking with Michael and the team at Wealthsimple for several years, as they grew and became a pioneer of the Canadian financial services industry transformation. We believe that their experienced management team, combined with a strong value proposition for consumers seeking true mobile-first financial management solutions, will allow the company to successfully expand their market position in the upcoming years.
Acquired by McKesson · December 2017

The WorkJam Digital Frontline Workplace unleashes the productivity and engagement of frontline workers and of the enterprise workforce through agile scheduling and task transformative communication, experiential learning, and tailored recognition. Available in over 28 languages & deployed in over 42 countries, WorkJam increases sales conversion & CSAT, drives down labour costs, lowers absenteeism and attrition rates, improves compliance and improves the customer experience through a more skilled, motivated and engaged workforce. For employees, WorkJam delivers more opportunity and control over their schedule, providing work-life balance, as well as the tools to develop skills, improve business acumen, and maximize their earnings to advance their economic well-being.
xmemory is a schema-grounded memory layer that gives AI agents reliable, queryable state instead of best-effort recall.
Zellify is a platform of web onboarding funnels that let mobile app companies convert and monetise users outside the app stores.
Zero Point Cryogenics is a manufacturer of premium, customizable dilution refrigerators and cryogenic infrastructure for quantum and low-temperature research.
